I added a "Catalogue de données" block at the end of the page, after the existing blocks. It lists every dataset published on the portal and has a search bar.

- **Block type:** Catalogue de données, which lists all datasets and lets visitors search them. I chose it over "Liste de jeux de données", which only shows the latest few.
- **Search:** the filter list contains only "Barre de recherche", so visitors get a search field and no other filters.
- **Other settings:** I left the defaults, which are sorting by most recent creation date, 2 columns, the result count shown above the filters, and the API documentation button shown.

The form is valid. I did not check how the block renders on the live portal.
